chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The one who is seized in the month of Ramadan and had broken his fast, so it is raised to the Imam, he would be killed on the third (offence).
ai.seo_question: What is the penalty for breaking the fast of Ramadan according to this hadith from al-Kafi?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi specifies the hadd penalty for deliberate fasting-breakers in Ramadan, noting execution upon the third occurrence if referred to the Imam. In Shia jurisprudence, this ruling is often discussed in the context of whether the penalty applies to both men and women and how it interacts with other minor sins, reflecting the authority of the Imam in administering justice. The mention of 'the third' implies a cumulative process of warning and punishment, emphasizing the gravity of violating the sanctity of Ramadan.
